entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data independently corroborate the component's substantive Latin and expose accidental editorial variants for collation.

locator.section: Postcommunion above the new Feria Tertia heading; full accented relative conclusion through Deus

entries.claim: The printed accented middle supplies w030–w039 and Deus w045 and corroborates the relative formula. It has no comma after Christum, has tuum: Qui and Sancti, Deus. The selected same-Spirit wording is positively supplied by the Vigil proper cue and RG 115 e, not by an unprinted eiusdem on p. 123. Printed Deus. is reintegrated as Deus, before the terminal duration.

locator.section: Top chant line: Per omnia saecula saeculorum and response Amen

entries.claim: The printed terminal formula and response supply w046–w050. Chant syllable divisions are joined, the response marker omitted and uppercase printed Per becomes house per. Source words do not by themselves determine the independent selected speaker/voice boundaries.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 a; full Father-addressed conclusion and Amen

entries.claim: RG 115 a supplies the complete Father-addressed expansion rule and Amen. Its rubric typography is not an independent attestation of every selected accent or house punctuation seam.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 e; same Spirit in the conclusion when named in the oration

entries.claim: All three Vigil orations name the Holy Spirit in their body; RG 115 e requires in unitate eiusdem Spiritus Sancti. The proper cue itself positively prints accented eiusdem; the rule is applicability evidence, not an invented accent witness.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.

locator.section: Proper body w001–w027; abbreviated Per Dominum cue w028–w029 and the printed in unitate eiusdem tail w040–w044; intervening and terminal formula words are separately expanded.

entries.claim: The identified proper page prints the bounded body and abbreviated cues described in the locator, not the whole contiguous expanded selected text. Formula/rule dependencies and house reintegration are separately declared in the witness record.
